svg.title: SDV microkernel architecture
svg.desc: Microkernel architecture for SDV framework: stable core with IModuleControl (Load/Unload), IRepository/IObjectAccess component registry, and IInterfaceAccess query pattern. Platform service modules and user-developed vehicle/basic/complex service modules loaded dynamically at runtime.

g.text: Minimal · stable · all functionality delivered as plug-in modules

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does IModuleControl Load and Unload do in the SDV core?')
sendPrompt('What does IRepository and IObjectAccess provide in the SDV core?')
g.text: Stable component registry — GetObject / CreateObject by class name
Component lookup by name · shared object lifetime management

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does IInterfaceAccess.GetInterface work in the SDV core?')
g.text: GetInterface<TInterface>() — inter-module communication without direct coupling

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the SDV core load modules at startup?')
g.text: Reads config · instantiates enabled modules via IModuleControl.Load()

sendPrompt('What does the can_communication_sim module do?')
sendPrompt('What does the data_dispatch_service module do?')
sendPrompt('What does the task_timer module do?')
sendPrompt('What do ipc_com, ipc_shared_mem, and process_control modules do?')

svg.text: user-developed modules — loaded on top of same stable core

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are vehicle function modules in the SDV framework?')
sendPrompt('What are basic service modules in the SDV framework?')
sendPrompt('What are complex service modules in the SDV framework?')

svg.text: New modules added without touching the core — implement module interface · register via IRepository · load via IModuleControl
